_doc: The vehicle layer (task 12b): VIEW ONLY. Cars, buses, taxis, emergency vehicles, tow trucks and bikes drawn on the road graph of data/map_layout.json near the camera. It reads the sim (Transport.active, Transport.cars, the bus timetable, VehicleFeed events) and never writes sim state or draws from a sim rng. Speeds are tiles per real second at game speed 1 (a tile is a metre); at speed 2 they are x speed_scale[2]; at every game speed (max_speed 3) the vehicles stay drawn and move at speed_scale; nothing appears or disappears on the picture (task 37).

bays._doc: the places themselves (driveway, bays, lay-by) are made by LotParking from data/parking.json

filler._doc: Through traffic (VehicleFiller): cars per hour entering from the road ends, by hour (curve, weekday) or (curve_weekend), x the day of the week; floor_per_hour keeps a few cars at 3 am. Cause: a town has through traffic and customers, so the roads are busy at the rush hours, quiet at night, and the main road (main_weight) carries most.

lights._doc: Vehicle lamps (task 42, VehicleLights / VehicleLightRigs; display only). Headlights are on when daylight x weather light is under 0.55, in fog or in rain or snow; real lights only for the nearest few, the rest use the emissive lamps and the beam decal. Low beam reaches about 17 m (VehicleLights.BEAM_LEN).
